name: Create Trip

overview.en: [excited] Let's create a Trip! Think of this... as planning the actual delivery or wash route. [friendly] We just need a type, a route, a driver, and a vehicle. Let's get moving!
overview.hi: [excited] चलिए एक Trip बनाते हैं! इसे... actual delivery या wash route plan करने की तरह सोचिए। [friendly] हमें बस एक type, एक route, एक driver, और एक vehicle चाहिए। चलते हैं!

explanation.en: [curious] What kind of trip? An ORDER trip for customer deliveries... or a WASH trip to the laundry? Let's pick ORDER_TRIP.
explanation.hi: [curious] किस तरह की trip? Customer deliveries के लिए ORDER trip... या laundry के लिए WASH trip? चलिए ORDER_TRIP चुनते हैं।

explanation.en: [casual] Which route are we taking? Let's select... Idhi 3rd route.
explanation.hi: [casual] हम कौन सा route ले रहे हैं? चलिए... Idhi 3rd route select करते हैं।

explanation.en: [casual] When is the delivery happening? Just pick the date.
explanation.hi: [casual] delivery कब होगी? बस date चुनें।

explanation.en: [casual] Who's handling the run? Search and pick the team member... like Nishant.
explanation.hi: [casual] यह run कौन handle करेगा? team member को search करके चुनें... जैसे Nishant।

explanation.en: [casual] And which VEHICLE are they using? Let's assign the Cargo.
explanation.hi: [casual] और वो कौन सा VEHICLE use करेंगे? चलिए Cargo assign करते हैं।

explanation.en: [casual] Any special instructions for the driver? Jot them down here.
explanation.hi: [casual] driver के लिए कोई special instructions हैं? यहाँ लिख दें।

wrapUp.en: [warm and satisfied] And that's a wrap! [chuckles] Your trip is ready to roll. Nothing was saved here... but whenever you're ready, go schedule a REAL trip. You've got this!
wrapUp.hi: [warm and satisfied] और यह हो गया! [chuckles] आपकी trip चलने के लिए तैयार है। यहाँ कुछ भी save नहीं हुआ... लेकिन जब भी तैयार हों, जाइए और एक REAL trip schedule करें। आप यह कर सकते हैं!

description: Walkthrough for creating a new delivery or wash trip
